question: Geeta Chandran received the Padma Shri in 2007 who is an acclaimed _______ dancer.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Geeta Chandran** is an acclaimed **Bharatanatyam** dancer.
 
• She received the prestigious **Padma Shri** in **2007** for her contributions to the art.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a classical dance form originating from the **state of Tamil Nadu** in southern India.
 
• This dance form is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is traditionally performed by women, but now both men and women perform it.
 
• The dance form is accompanied by music and a language of hand gestures called **mudras**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sattriya**__

 __
 
• **Sattriya** is one of the eight principal classical Indian dance traditions.
 
• It originated in the state of **Assam** and was introduced by the great Vaishnavite saint **Sankardev** in the 15th-16th century AD.
 
 
 
• **Odissi**__
 __
 
• **Odissi** is a classical dance form from the state of **Odisha**.
 
• It is known for its fluidity, grace, and intricate movements.
 
• **Odissi** often depicts mythological stories and religious themes.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam**__
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form from the state of **Kerala**.
 
• It is characterized by graceful and swaying body movements.
 
• Mohiniyattam is traditionally performed by women and has themes of love and devotion.
